description: List of all project Action Plan Parties

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort the collection by full name. Ascending by default; prefix the value with a hyphen (`-name`) to sort descending.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

id.description: Unique identifier for this party person within the project directory.

first_name.description: First name of the party person.

last_name.description: Last name of the party person.

name.description: Full display name of the party person (first and last name combined).

id.description: Unique identifier of the vendor company this party person belongs to.

name.description: Name of the vendor company this party person belongs to.

user_id.description: User ID of the login account associated with this party person. Null if the party person has no login account.

is_employee.description: Whether this party person is an employee of the current company, as opposed to an external vendor contact.

employee_id.description: Employee ID string for this party person. Null if no employee ID is assigned.

potential_approver.description: Whether this party person is eligible to serve as an Action Plan approver. Use to filter candidates when assigning approvers.

potential_assignee.description: Whether this party person is eligible to be assigned to Action Plan items. Use to filter candidates when assigning item assignees.

potential_manager.description: Whether this party person is eligible to serve as an Action Plan manager. Use to filter candidates when assigning plan managers.

potential_receiver.description: Whether this party person is eligible to serve as an Action Plan receiver. Use to filter candidates when assigning receivers.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this party person record was last updated.

login.description: Email address (login) of the party person's user account. Null if no login account exists.
